citations.name: Wesley Guynn Glasgow
citations.assertion: Previously cited subject; no additional family role asserted. The original 1850 Smith County household 1186, lines 2–9, contains the head indexed as Neely Glassgow, 32, farmer, Virginia 29, and the six indexed children Joicy A 9, John W 8, Elizabeth D 6, Andrew G 5, Holly J 3 and James W 11 months, all recorded as Tennessee-born. This is the existing Wesley-family source, not a newly discovered household. The original head’s handwriting is compatible with Wesley/Wesly; the index’s Neely reading and the later-life identification are kept distinct. No parent is named and no relationship column appears in this schedule. Wesley-2476’s selected father James-2492 remains Possible at 35%; James-2492’s own father James-634 remains Confident at 94%. The census age slots are compatible household evidence, not named kin or independent birth entries. No new parent, exact vital date, maternal attachment, profile merger or confidence gain follows. The cited indexes and their newly inspected originals describe the same underlying events and are not independent witnesses. Wesley Guynn Glasgow: Previously cited subject; no additional family role asserted Reviewed 2026-10-31; research/ancestry-connections/maryland-smith-county-review-2026-10-23.json
